verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI explicitly supports LLM-driven structured extraction without pre-written CSS/XPath selectors, letting an LLM infer schema/fields directly, plus a CLI query mode (`-q "Extract all product prices"`) that demonstrates natural-language field extraction. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of extraction accuracy/field-selection quality, and detailed docs on how schema-free LLM field inference is configured versus schema-based extraction.
